create_post.title: Send post
create_post.description: Send a notice, an event or a volunteer call to chosen groups. It is read-only once sent.

args.description: Who sent the post, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

get_post.title: Read post
get_post.description: Read one post with its kind, details and state.

mark_read.title: Mark notice read
mark_read.description: Record that the caller has read a sent notice to one of their groups. Marking it again returns the first marker.

args.description: Who read it, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

count_unread.title: Unread notices
count_unread.description: How many sent notices to the caller's groups the caller has not read. The groups come from the mount, never from the request, and a mount that supplies none reaches nothing.

args.description: Who is counting, supplied by the mount.

answer_rsvp.title: Answer event
answer_rsvp.description: Answer a sent event to one of the caller's groups with going or not_going. Answering again replaces the answer until the event starts.

args.description: The event answered. The address decides, not the body.
Who answered, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.
